description_en: Queries the virtual storage channel information associated with a file system
description_zh: 查询文件系统关联的虚拟存储通道信息
kebab_example: aliyun nas describe-filesystems-vsc-attach-info --resource-ids VscId=vsc-8vb864o3ppwfvh0000 FileSystemId=bmcpfs-290t15yn4uo8lid0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeFilesystemsVscAttachInfo

parameters.help_en: The ID information of file systems and virtual storage channels. A maximum of 10 entries can be specified per batch
parameters.help_zh: 文件系统和虚拟存储通道的 ID 信息，每批次最多 10 个
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en: The query token. Set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of results for each query.

Valid values: 10 to 100.
Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每次查询结果的个数。

取值范围：10~100。
默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

fields.help_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account, which specifies the account on whose behalf the service assumes the role
fields.help_zh: 云帐号UID（即主账号UID），指明服务在替哪个云帐号扮演角色
fields.name: assume_role_for

fields.help_en: The resource descriptor of the specified role. Format: acs:ram::$accountID:role/$roleName
fields.help_zh: 指定角色的资源描述符。格式：acs:ram::$accountID:role/$roleName
fields.name: role_arn

fields.help_en: The role type. Valid values: service and user
fields.name: role_type

parameters.help_en:
The role chain.
Required only for cross-account scenarios
parameters.help_zh:
角色链。
仅跨账号场景需要
parameters.name: role_chain

MaxResults.description_en:
The number of entries returned per query.

Valid values: 10 to 1000.

Default value: 10
MaxResults.description_zh:
每次查询返回目录的个数。

取值范围：10~1000。

默认值：10

NextToken.description_en: The query token. Set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
NextToken.description_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of association entries

VscAttachInfo.description_en: The collection of data for file systems associated with vchannels
VscAttachInfo.description_zh: 文件系统和虚拟通道关联数据集合

Status.description_en:
The status of the file system associated with the vchannel. Valid values:

Attaching: Being associated.
Attached: Associated.
Detaching: Being dissociated.
Detached: Dissociated.
Failed: Association failed
Status.description_zh:
文件系统和虚拟通道关联状态。包括：

Attaching: 正在关联。
Attached：关联完成。
Detaching：正在取消关联。
Detached：取消关联完成。
Failed：关联失败
